Re-pin each Monday with `python3 -I scripts/perf-lab/reference.py pin --sha SHA --config bench --digest sha256:HEX --by NAME` (the digest perf-lab-build.sh printed for that sha and config) and commit this file. pin null: no reference runs yet.
